attempts.summary: Configured VRRP-based shared VIP (10.100.179.50) between node1 and node2 via keepalived (UCI-managed on OpenWrt 25.12.2), with node1 as MASTER (priority 150) and node2 as BACKUP (priority 100) on the shared br-lan network with node3. Demonstrated failover by stopping keepalived on node1 while node3 ran a continuous ping against the VIP: node2 took over the address and node3's ping never lost a sequence number (only a brief latency spike, all 57 packets eventually answered), proving zero-loss failover. Restored node1 to standby. Then executed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes sequentially (node2 backup first, then node1 master — which caused a second live failover to node2 with zero packet loss observed from node3 — then node3 last), capturing pre/post boot_id changes and post-restart service/VIP health on each node. Final state: node1 MASTER holding VIP, node2 healthy BACKUP, node3 reaching the VIP successfully.
